title: Hexus Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Mr Blue by Hexus blends three popular berries into a smooth and fruity vape. Blackberry adds depth with its dark, jammy flavour, while Blueberry brings a soft, mellow sweetness. Raspberry sharpens the mix with a slight tang, rounding out the profile with a balanced and satisfying finish. It’s a familiar berry medley that delivers full flavour with every puff. Made with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides rapid nicotine absorption and a smooth, tactile throat hit. It’s blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter devices and vape pens. Part of the Hexus Nic Salt collection, Mr Blue is available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, alongside a wide range of fruity, fizzy and icy blends.
